summary: iter185 — Strict payment system verified. 26/26 unit tests pass (11 new + 15 iter175 regression). 9/10 live API tests pass against preview backend (1 skipped: no non-deposit listing available to prove 400 rejection on deposit-charge). UI: CreateListingPage renders all required deposit + currency + seller-disclosure testids; Admin > Strict Payment Charges page renders with all 3 sub-tabs (charges/events/queue). ListingDetailPage deposit/payment-method notices, BidConfirmationDialog disclaimer, BuyNowButton modal disclaimer, and TrustVerification setup-intent block could NOT be verified end-to-end from the UI (listings fetch returned empty array in the test harness, and /profile does not render TrustVerification).

minor.issue: Response keys are {by_status, failed_jobs} — fine but worth documenting in OpenAPI so clients don't key on 'stats'/'pending'.

ui_bugs.issue: [data-testid=setup-intent-no-silent-charges] not found on /profile — the block is defined in TrustVerification.js but that component is not rendered on the /profile route, so the spec check ('renders setup-intent-no-silent-charges block') is unverifiable end-to-end. Main agent should confirm which route renders TrustVerification (likely /profile/verify, /settings/payment, or the card-save drawer) and either add a data-testid anchor on that route or link it from /profile.

integration_issues.issue: Our harness fetch of /api/listings?limit=10 returned no items inside the Playwright request context (items array empty), so we could not navigate to /listing/{id} to assert bid-deposit-required-notice / bid-no-deposit-notice / bid-stripe-payment-notice / bid-cash-payment-notice / bid-disclaimer / buy-now-disclaimer. Main agent should self-verify on a known-live listing.

action_items: Confirm which route renders <TrustVerification/> (setup-intent-no-silent-charges block) and expose a stable entry point, or mount it on /profile so the spec check passes end-to-end.

Main agent self-verify ListingDetailPage deposit + payment-method notices + BidConfirmationDialog + BuyNowButton modal on a known-active listing ID (our Playwright request context returned 0 listings during testing — likely auth/CORS-from-browser-context oddity, not a bug, but worth a sanity pass).
Consider adding a non-deposit public listing in seed data so automated tests can exercise the POST /api/bidder-deposits/charge 400 'no deposit required' path without relying on production data shape.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/services/payment_idempotency.py: build_idempotency_key enforces charge_type whitelist + reserve_charge_row enforces CAD/USD-only — correct per spec. DuplicateChargeBlocked logs DUPLICATE_CHARGE_BLOCKED event row, exactly as spec demands.

/app/backend/services/deposit_refund_queue.py: enqueue_non_winner_refunds correctly skips winner_user_id; worker uses PaymentIntent.cancel and marks deposit row refunded atomically — behaviour verified by test_refund_queue_processes_and_marks_succeeded.

/app/backend/services/auction_settlement.py: settle_auction() branches on listing.payment_method and settle_stripe_full enforces WINNER_MISMATCH_BLOCKED (rejects if winner_user_id != listing.winner_id) with DB event log — verified by two dedicated tests.

/app/backend/routes/listings.py: POST /listings rejects requires_deposit=true without deposit_amount/deposit_type and rejects invalid deposit_type — both returned 422 (Pydantic) which satisfies 'rejects with 400+bilingual messages' requirement; however, we could not verify bilingual EN+FR body in 422 since FastAPI 422 doesn't surface custom detail. If bilingual message is strictly required in the HTTP error body, consider intercepting and returning HTTP 400 with the bilingual string explicitly.

AdminPaymentChargesPage loads admin-payment-charges-page with charges/events/queue tabs — looks good. /api/admin/payment-charges returns {rows, summary} which matches spec; /refund-queue returns {by_status, failed_jobs} — spec said 'queue stats + failed jobs' so this is compliant.
Scheduler now shows 32 jobs in admin Scheduler Status panel (vs spec note '14 jobs'); deposit_refund_queue tick every 10s is present and executing (auto_capture_overdue_deposits visible as well).

success_rate.frontend_testid_coverage: ~70% — CreateListingPage + AdminPaymentChargesPage fully verified; ListingDetail + BidConfirmation + BuyNow + TrustVerification not reachable in this run
